amritmahal.name: Amritmahal
amritmahal.features: Mysore-type; grey, from almost white to near black; long horns ending in sharp black points, rising upward and backward.

ayrshire.name: Ayrshire (exotic)
ayrshire.features: Red/brown and white patched dairy breed.
ayrshire.notes: Exotic breed, used in India mainly for crossbreeding.

bachaur.name: Bachaur
bachaur.features: Grey or greyish white; coffin-shaped skull.
bachaur.notes: Bullocks can work long periods; thrives on poor fodder.

badri.name: Badri
badri.features: Small (200-250 kg); black, brown, red, white or grey; horns curved upward and inward; prominent hump.
badri.notes: First registered cattle breed of Uttarakhand; well adapted to hilly terrain.

bargur.name: Bargur
bargur.features: Mysore-type, evolved from Hallikar; mainly red.

bhelai.name: Belahi
bhelai.features: Medium sized; face and extremities typically white; small to medium hump.
bhelai.notes: Also called Morni; migratory hill-foot cattle.

dangi.name: Dangi
dangi.features: Short horns; spotted coat; oily skin secretion.
dangi.notes: Adapted to heavy rainfall and hilly tracts.

deoni.name: Deoni
deoni.features: Heavily built; usually spotted black and white; pendulous dewlap.
deoni.notes: Average milk about 868 kg per lactation, fat about 4.3%.

gangatari.name: Gangatiri
gangatari.notes: Also known as Shahabadi or Eastern Hariana.

gaolao.name: Gaolao
gaolao.features: White or light grey (males grey over the neck); short horns; almond-shaped eyes set at an angle.

gir.name: Gir
gir.features: Domed (convex) forehead; long drooping leaf-like ears; curved half-moon horns; red to speckled coat.
gir.notes: One of India's best-known dairy breeds; hardy and disease resistant.

hallikar.name: Hallikar
hallikar.features: Mysore-type; grey to dark grey; long pointed backward-curving horns.
hallikar.notes: Regarded as the best draught breed of South India.

hariana.name: Hariana
hariana.features: White or light grey; short horns; coffin-shaped skull.
hariana.notes: Well-known dual-purpose breed of North India.

himachalipahari.name: Himachali Pahari
himachalipahari.features: Black or blackish brown; compact cylindrical body; short legs; medium hump; horizontal ears.
himachalipahari.notes: About 1-3 kg milk per day (350-650 kg per lactation).

kangayam.name: Kangayam
kangayam.features: Calves red at birth, turning grey by about 6 months; bulls grey with darker hump and quarters.

kankrej.name: Kankrej
kankrej.features: Large, heavy breed; large lyre-shaped horns; silver-grey to iron-grey.
kankrej.notes: Known for its distinctive 'sawai chal' gait.

kenkatha.name: Kenkatha
kenkatha.features: Small, sturdy; grey or white; horns directed forward.

khariar.name: Khariar
khariar.features: Small, well-balanced sturdy body; tail ends in a thick black switch.
khariar.notes: Docile; hardy with natural disease resistance.

kherigarh.name: Kherigarh
kherigarh.features: White coat, some grey especially on the face; upstanding horns curving outward and upward.

khillari.name: Khillari
khillari.notes: Fast and powerful bullocks; related to Hallikar/Amritmahal.

konkankapila.name: Konkan Kapila
konkankapila.features: Various coats, mostly reddish brown or black; horns go upward and backward with pointed tips.
konkankapila.notes: Low milk (about 2.25 kg/day); good draught power in hilly, hot and humid terrain.

kosali.name: Kosali
kosali.features: Small; mostly light red, also white or black; small stumpy horns; horizontal ears.
kosali.notes: First registered breed of Chhattisgarh; efficient workers, high disease resistance.

ladakhi.name: Ladakhi
ladakhi.features: Small and short; black or brown.
ladakhi.notes: Adapted to high altitude, cold and low oxygen.

lakhimi.name: Lakhimi
lakhimi.features: Small; mainly brown or grey; medium hump; short limbs.
lakhimi.notes: Heat tolerant, disease resistant, survives on scarce feed; bullocks used in paddy cultivation.

malnadgidda.name: Malnad Gidda
malnadgidda.notes: Hardy hill cattle of the Western Ghats.

malvi.name: Malvi
malvi.features: Grey-white; lyre-shaped horns; horizontally held ears.

motu.name: Motu
motu.features: Small, strong; mainly reddish brown, sometimes grey; short straight upward horns.

nagori.name: Nagori
nagori.features: White or grey; narrow, long face.

nari.name: Nari
nari.notes: Native to Sirohi, Pali, Sabarkantha and Banaskantha.

nimari.name: Nimari
nimari.features: Red with white patches; copper-coloured muzzle.

ongole.name: Ongole
ongole.features: Large, muscular; white or light grey; short stumpy horns; large dewlap.
ongole.notes: Also called Nellore; hardy and disease resistant.

podathirupu.name: Poda Thurpu
podathirupu.notes: Excellent long migration over forest terrain; mainly draught.

pulikulam.name: Pulikulam
pulikulam.features: Small; grey to dark grey; well-developed hump.
pulikulam.notes: Kept in large migratory herds; used for penning fields and Jallikattu.

punganur.name: Punganur
punganur.features: Dwarf; short crescent horns; large hanging dewlap.

purnea.name: Purnea
purnea.features: Medium hump; small to medium dewlap; mostly flat poll.

rathi.name: Rathi
rathi.features: White or grey with patches; short horns.
rathi.notes: Good milker of the arid region.

redsindhi.name: Red Sindhi
redsindhi.features: Distinct red, darker than Sahiwal; pendulous dewlap.
redsindhi.notes: Heat tolerant; average about 1840 kg milk per lactation.

sahiwal.name: Sahiwal
sahiwal.features: Reddish brown; loose skin; heavy dewlap; long tail.
sahiwal.notes: Considered the best indigenous dairy breed.

shwetakapila.name: Shweta Kapila
shwetakapila.features: Completely white, from muzzle to tail.
shwetakapila.notes: Average 510 kg milk per lactation with high fat (about 5.2%); suited to hot, humid weather.

siri.name: Siri
siri.features: Small; black-and-white or brown-and-white patches; hump with a tuft of hair.

tharparkar.name: Tharparkar
tharparkar.features: White or light grey; lyre-shaped horns.
tharparkar.notes: Also called White Sindhi; very hardy in arid conditions.

thutho.name: Thutho
thutho.features: Medium, well-built; mostly black (bulls darker); about 40% have white face spots.
thutho.notes: Hardy and docile; low milk (0.5-1.5 kg/day).

umblachery.name: Umblachery
umblachery.features: White star on the face, white socks below the hocks, white hooves.
umblachery.notes: Suited to marshy delta paddy fields.

vechur.name: Vechur
vechur.notes: Among the smallest humped cattle in the world.

dagri.name: Dagri
dagri.features: Mostly white, sometimes grey; small; horns curved upward-outward; small horizontal ears.
dagri.notes: Low feed need, survives mainly on grazing; also called Gujarat Malvi.
